Custom Web Development & Architectural Specifications

At SOCIAL DEV AGENCY, websites are engineered completely from scratch using clean, scalable, and performance-focused code architectures.

Performance Standards

No restrictive template dependencies.
Optimized loading speed and security-first architecture.
Core Web Vitals optimization targeting high mobile performance scores.
Semantic HTML implementation across layouts to improve accessibility and AI readability.
Modern React and Vite development workflow for fast rendering and scalability.

Complimentary Maintenance Structure

Every custom website project includes 2 to 3 months of complimentary post-launch technical maintenance.

Support includes:

24/7 server uptime monitoring.
Security updates and SSL integration support.
Minor layout edits and content updates.
Performance optimization and technical troubleshooting.
